content.short: Digital dollar wallet with many add/withdraw methods and virtual cards.
content.description: Airtm, founded in 2015, is a US-headquartered digital dollar platform serving individuals and businesses across Latin America and other emerging markets. It provides a dollar-denominated wallet backed by USDC, letting users add and withdraw funds through more than 500 local payment methods, hold balances in digital dollars, and spend via virtual cards. For businesses, Airtm powers mass payouts, payroll, and marketplace disbursements, converting between local currencies, fiat, and USDC on networks such as Ethereum and Polygon. By combining a peer-to-peer liquidity network with stablecoin rails, Airtm helps people in economies with currency instability preserve value and move money across borders quickly and at lower cost than traditional banking channels.
